name: Matthew Owen
abstract_title: Human cerebral organoids and consciousness: the contrasting implications of physicalism and hylomorphism
abstract: Human cerebral organoids (HCOs) can be described as miniature three-dimensional biological models of the human brain derived from human embryonic or induced pluripotent stem cells. Insofar as these organoids accurately resemble the cerebrum in the human brain, HCOs can significantly advance our understanding of the brain and propel progress in neurology.
